summary_en: This study tests a chemotherapy plan called lymphodepleting chemotherapy, given before CAR T cell therapy, in adults with multiple myeloma, lymphoma, or acute lymphoblastic leukemia who have moderate to severe kidney problems. Fludarabine and cyclophosphamide are given through an IV on days -5 to -3 before CAR T cell therapy, with doses lowered based on kidney function. The study is a Phase 2 study that assesses the feasibility of giving CAR T therapy with this dose-adjusted chemotherapy; the primary outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa un plan de quimioterapia llamado quimioterapia linfodepletiva, administrada antes de la terapia con células CAR T, en adultos con mieloma múltiple, linfoma o leucemia linfoblástica aguda que tienen problemas renales de moderados a graves. La fludarabina y la ciclofosfamida se administran por vía intravenosa en los días -5 a -3 antes de la terapia con células CAR T, con dosis ajustadas según la función renal. Es un estudio de Fase 2 que evalúa la viabilidad de administrar la terapia CAR T con esta quimioterapia con dosis ajustadas; la medida de resultado principal no está indicada.
who_for: Receiving lymphodepleting chemotherapy before commercial CAR T therapy for multiple myeloma, leukemia, or lymphoma
Adequate bone marrow function to receive lymphodepleting chemotherapy
Renal function at or below 60 mL/min/1.73m2
not_for: Active uncontrolled infection or other condition the investigator judges would interfere with the study
Therapeutic-dose systemic corticosteroids (more than 20 mg/day prednisone or equivalent) within 72 hours of CAR T administration
